notes.title: Hold The Noise
notes.content:
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2860220/Hold_The_Noise/]Hold The Noise[/url]

Hi. My name is !CyberApex, Yechan Choi.
Finally, the new work has been approved and uploaded to the Steam page.

This is an experimental game where you score points by listening to beautiful noise while holding the space bar down.

I set the price for free.

I look forward to working with you this year. Thank you.

notes.title: Roots Need Control 3.0 in the DCCF!
notes.content:
Hello everyone. I'm !CyberApex.
This notice is limited to the Korean, but it is explained in English.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090378/722e324ac3eca945001180adb651beec3d4d551c.jpg[/img]

[b]Roots Need Control 3.0 will participate and exhibit in the "DCCF Indie Game Special Exhibition" held in Daegu Metropolitan City![/b]

The event will be held in Korea and will be held from October 6th to October 7th in Korean time.
Places and addresses are as follows.

[list]
[*]10, Exco-ro, Buk-gu, Daegu, Republic of Korea (Daegu EXCO)
[/list]

In addition, Roots Need Control's mini project "RNC Mini" will be on display.
If you visit Daegu, Korea, for the play of RNC 3.0 and RNC Mini, welcome!

Thank you for reading it. See you in Daegu.

notes.title: Roots Need Controller
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44090378/04f67058549a6ab4ecae5dd9192cf207516488a9.png[/img]

Roots Need Control 3.0 does not support game pads.
However, Steam Input has also made gameplay possible on RNC 3.0.

Introduces an input layout called [b]Roots Need Controller[/b].
[b]Roots Need Controller[/b] provides gameplay using gyro sensors.

For operating instructions, check the Steam Input setting.
[b]Currently, Roots Need Controller only supports dual-sense (PlayStation 5 controllers).[/b]
Support for the XBox controller is undecided, but we'll hurry.

Thank you!
- !CyberApex

notes.title: Roots Need Chungnam 8.7
notes.content:
Hello, I'm !CyberApex.
Roots Need Control 3.0's external DLC game project "Roots Need Chungnam 8.7" will be released.

Roots Need Chungnam 8.7 is a separate game, not an extension of Roots Need Control 3.0,
There may be some gameability differences except for the base system, and the save file will be separated separately.

Protect the root flower for a long time in the changing background and the type of enemy that appears according to the changing map!
The price will be released when the page is released.

Please wait! Thank you.

notes.title: Roots Need Control 3.0 on Steam!
notes.content:
Hello. [b]!CyberApex[/b].
[b]Roots Need Control 3.0 has been uploaded to Steam page.[/b]

Roots Need Control 3.0 has already been released on other platforms, but Steam is now available.
Now feel free to play Roots Need Control 3.0 on Steam!

[i]Roots Need Control 3.0 is a root defense game in which you have to protect root flowers from a coalition of large corporations that threaten root flowers. You should use CrossHair to destroy enemies that threaten the root flower and keep the root flower alive by shortening its growing roots. The goal of this game is to make the progress reach 100%.[/i]

The game is scheduled to be released on May 24.
And May 20th.. It will also be introduced at "INDIE Live Expo 2023," Japan's largest online indie game introduction event.

Please look forward to it! Thank you.
